purpose: Prepared Amazon ASIN mapping for cart deployment; no order or checkout action was performed.

deployment_policy.ready_exact: Identity matched in prior Amazon.com variation research only; live price, stock, seller, and delivery still require review.
deployment_policy.ready_substitute: Selected substitute identity documented in prior research; material fit/fabric/color tradeoffs and current offer require review.
deployment_policy.manual_review: The row remains in the list, but the Amazon.com child offer or exact variant must be confirmed by a person before adding it to an official cart.
deployment_policy.final_checkout: Always requires user confirmation of the final items, prices, delivery, address, and payment before placing an order.
deployment_policy.live_offer_gate: Every saved row is auto_cart_eligible=false until its live offer is reviewed. Identification readiness does not authorize cart mutation or purchase.
